title: The Witch's Hut
text: A hut on chicken legs scratches in the leaves, turning to face you, its door creaking open. The witch inside is all knuckles and teeth. She offers a trade: a year of your life for a cure. She has jars of years on her shelves.

options.label: The most wounded trades her a year.

outcomes.text: The wound closes. They feel older, and they move like it.
A month instead of a year, and the cure is good.
She is insulted, and she is a witch.
The hut follows a while, then loses interest. Where its claws scratched the path it left a bundle of good herbs.
The hut follows a while, then loses interest, and the witch leans out and spits after you.

options.label: The one in a hood haggles with her, witch to witch.

outcomes.text: She cackles, and takes a lock of hair instead of a year, and the cure is real.
